inicio.entrada: Read the terms of each call, fill in your application at your own pace and submit it once it is complete.
inicio.sin_convocatorias: There are no published calls at the moment.
inicio.paso1_texto: We only ask for an email address, your name and a password. The same account works every year.
inicio.paso2_texto: Your application saves itself as you type. You can pick it up another day or from another device.
inicio.paso3_texto: On submission you will receive a PDF receipt by email with your reference number. After submitting you can no longer edit.

admin.retroceder: Go back to the previous stage
admin.max_videos: Maximum number of video links (0 to 3)
admin.bases_ayuda: In Markdown: # Title, ## Subtitle, **bold**, *italics*, lists with “-” and links [text](https://…). This is how they appear on the public page.
admin.calendario_ayuda: Dates and times in Mexico City time. Stages must follow one another in time. To extend a deadline, change its date here.
admin.dotaciones_ayuda: This year’s catalogue of instrumentations. Instrumentations are not deleted: to stop offering one, untick “Offered to applicants”; works that already chose it keep it.
admin.requisitos_ayuda: The documents requested, per application or per work. In Composers, a requirement can apply to all instrumentations or to just one; one specific to an instrumentation overrides the general rule with the same key.
admin.sin_requisitos: There are no document requirements yet.
admin.clave_ayuda: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores; for example “partitura”.
admin.criterios_ayuda: What the jury scores. They cannot be changed once evaluation has started.
admin.sin_criterios: There are no evaluation criteria yet.
admin.asignaciones_ayuda: Jurors: %d of %d. Reviewers: %d. Removing someone does not delete what they have done: it only revokes their access to this call.
admin.sin_asignaciones: No jurors or reviewers have been assigned yet.
admin.crear_y_asignar: Create an account and assign it
admin.crear_y_asignar_ayuda: The person receives an email with a link to set their password. Search first: if they already have an account, assign it.
admin.cuentas_entrada: Administration, observer, juror and reviewer accounts. Applicants create their own.
admin.nueva_cuenta_ayuda: For a juror or reviewer, leave the global role empty and assign it later in the call. The person receives an activation link by email.
admin.aviso_cuenta: Account created. The activation link has been sent.
admin.aviso_activacion: The activation link has been resent.
supervision.entrada: The progress of each call, its results, the reports and each edition’s statistics.
supervision.avance_jurados_ayuda: How many each juror has done out of how many. No scores are shown here.
supervision.ritmo_ayuda: Applications first submitted each day (Mexico City time)
supervision.sin_envios: No application has been submitted yet.
supervision.resultados_ayuda: Ordered by comparable score: the sum scaled to three jurors, so that a recusal does not penalise anyone. Ties share a place. Only submitted evaluations count.
supervision.sin_resultados: There are no applications in evaluation yet.
supervision.aviso_dictamen: Result saved. It is not communicated to the applicant.
supervision.reporte_no_procede: The report could not be generated:
supervision.nombre_plantilla_ayuda: To use this same definition in any call of this type, this year and the following ones.
supervision.plantilla_duplicada: There is already a template with that name.
supervision.estadisticas_entrada: Distributions of submitted applications, including discarded ones. Drafts do not count.
supervision.vista_previa: What would go to the portal
supervision.vista_previa_ayuda: Applications with the result “Selected”, with only their artistic name, subcategory, biography and work titles. No contact details, documents or scores.
supervision.sin_seleccionados: There are no selected applications yet.
supervision.publicar_ayuda: What is published is frozen: if a result changes later, it does not reach the portal until you publish again. Every publication is recorded.
supervision.confirmo_publicar: I confirm that I want to publish this list of %d selected applicants.
supervision.confirmo_retirar: I confirm that I want to withdraw the list from the portal.
supervision.publicar_solo_cerrada: The list can only be published once the call is closed.
archivo.entrada: Every edition in one place. Each person finds only what their role allows them to see, also years later.
archivo.buscar_ayuda: Reference number, name, artistic name, ensemble, members, work title, composer or email. Accents are ignored and fragments work: “arril” finds “Carrillo”.
archivo.sin_resultados: There are no applications with these filters.
archivo.vista_duplicada: You already have a view with that name.
archivo.descarga_masiva_ayuda: The documents of the applications found (%d), in one folder per reference number with a manifest of each file’s fingerprint. It is built in the background and we notify you by email; it is recorded.
archivo.tipos_ayuda: If none is ticked, all are included.
archivo.expediente_convocatoria_ayuda: A PDF with the applications found (%d), with an index. Its content is trimmed to your role.
archivo.expediente_elige_convocatoria: To get a call’s case file in PDF, choose the call in the filters.
archivo.descargas_entrada: The bulk downloads and case files you requested. Each can be downloaded for seven days, only from your account.
archivo.aviso_encolada: Requested. It is being built; we will email you when it is ready.
archivo.en_proceso: Some downloads are in progress; this list updates itself.
archivo.sin_descargas: You have not requested any download yet.
error.plantilla_desconocida: The email template does not exist.
error.asunto_invalido: The subject must be a single line of up to 200 characters.
error.variable_desconocida: The text uses a variable this template does not receive: it would appear as-is in the email.
error.variable_obligatoria: A variable the email needs to serve its purpose is missing.
correo.entrada: Every email the platform sends, in Spanish and English. Each change is a new version; emails already queued do not change.
correo.falta_idioma: Missing: the Spanish one is used
correo.falta_idioma_aviso: There is no version in this language yet: those who prefer it receive the Spanish one. The editor shows that one as a starting point.
correo.version_cargada: The editor holds version %d (the current one is %d). To go back to it, save it as a new version.
correo.desconocidas: Variables this template does not receive:
correo.cuerpo_ayuda: In Markdown: **bold**, *italics*, lists with “-” and links [text](https://…). Variables go between double braces.
correo.guardar_ayuda: The preview saves nothing. The test reaches your inbox with sample values.
correo.vista_previa_ayuda: With sample values. This is how the email will look.
correo.sin_versiones: There are no versions in this language yet.
correo.aviso_guardada: Version saved. It is used from now on.
correo.aviso_prueba: Test queued: it will reach your inbox.
correo.proposito.verificar_email: To an applicant who registers or changes email: the verification link.
correo.proposito.reset_password: To whoever asks to recover their password.
correo.proposito.activacion: To a new internal account (juror, reviewer, observer): the link to choose a password.
correo.proposito.cambio_email: To the previous address, when an account changes it.
correo.proposito.acuse: To the applicant on submission: reference number and PDF acknowledgement attached.
correo.proposito.recordatorio_borrador: To whoever has an unsent draft as the deadline approaches.
correo.proposito.subsanacion: To the applicant: what to correct and by when.
correo.proposito.acuse_subsanacion: To the applicant on resubmission: new PDF acknowledgement.
correo.proposito.aviso_subsanada: To reviewers: a corrected application awaits review.
correo.proposito.exportacion_lista: To whoever requested a bulk download or a case file.
correo.proposito.alerta_disco: To administrators, when space is running low.
correo.variable.convocatoria: Title of the call, in the email’s language.
correo.variable.lista_problemas: What the reviewer flagged, one line per item.
correo.variable.nota: Reviewer’s free note; may be empty.
correo.variable.vence: Until when it can be downloaded.
bitacora.entrada: Every change is recorded here: who, when, from where and what changed. Nothing is deleted.
bitacora.sin_asientos: There are no records with these filters.
importacion.entrada: Instrumentation catalogues and juror and reviewer accounts from a spreadsheet. Nothing is guessed: a person resolves each doubtful row, and either everything goes in or nothing does.
importacion.nueva_ayuda: First step: the sheet is analysed without writing anything. Then you resolve the doubtful rows and confirm.
importacion.hoja_ayuda: .csv (UTF-8) or .xlsx, up to 2 MB, with headers in the first row. Instrumentations: nombre_es (required), nombre_en, descripcion_es, descripcion_en. Accounts: email, nombre and apellidos (required), idioma.
importacion.hoja_conservada: The original sheet is kept. SHA-256:
importacion.conflictos_ayuda: The system does not decide whether two records are the same: you do. A resolution can be changed until you confirm.
importacion.sin_candidatos_n: %d rows do not resemble anything that exists:
importacion.crear_cuenta: It is a new account: create it and send its link
importacion.confirmar_ayuda: Everything goes in as one operation: if a row cannot go in, none does and you are told which.
importacion.confirmar_cuentas: New accounts receive their activation link by email.
importacion.confirmo: I confirm that I want to apply this import.
importacion.faltan_resolver: %d rows must be resolved before you can confirm.
arco.entrada: Handles a personal-data cancellation request (LFPDPPP): deletes an application’s contact details and keeps the work, the decision and the statistics.
arco.no_existe: There is no application with that reference number.
arco.ya_anonimizada: This application has already been anonymised.
arco.advertencia_titulo: This is the only operation in the system that cannot be undone.
arco.advertencia: The name, artistic name, contact details, biography, members, links, date of birth (only the year is kept) and personal documents, such as the photograph and authorisations, are deleted. Scores, parts, audio, decisions and marks are kept. It is recorded in the audit log with its basis.
arco.fundamento_ayuda: The reference of the ARCO request (document number, date). No personal data: it stays in the audit log.
arco.reescribe_folio: To confirm, type the reference number %s again
arco.con_cuenta: Also anonymise the account, if it has no other applications
arco.confirmo: I understand this cannot be undone.
arco.pendientes_n: %d files could not be deleted from disk: “fimnme-cli verify” will flag them.
tema.cambiar: Change the theme: auto (your system's), light or dark
bloqueo.duracion_insuficiente: The total duration of the programme is below the required minimum.
error.duracion_min_mayor: The minimum length cannot be greater than the maximum.
form.formato_fecha: Format: dd/mm/yyyy, day first (for example, 29/01/2027 for 29 January 2027).
form.formato_fecha_hora: Mexico City date and time, as dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm, 24-hour clock (for example, 29/01/2027 23:59).
error.fecha_hora_invalida: The date and time are not valid: write them as dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm (for example, 29/01/2027 23:59).
segundo_factor.entrada: Enter the six-digit code your authenticator app shows for this account.
segundo_factor.codigo_ayuda: The six digits the app shows; they change every 30 seconds.
segundo_factor.codigo_o_recuperacion: The six digits from the app or, if you don't have your phone, one of your recovery codes (xxxx-xxxx).
segundo_factor.sin_telefono: Lost your phone and your recovery codes? Ask the system's technical lead to reset your two-step verification.
segundo_factor.alta_entrada: Your account sees sensitive information from every application. Besides your password, signing in will ask for a code from an app on your phone. You set it up once.
segundo_factor.alta_paso1: Install an authenticator app on your phone: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy, 2FAS, Aegis or FreeOTP.
segundo_factor.alta_paso2: In the app, add an account and scan this QR code:
segundo_factor.alta_clave: If you can't scan it, type this key:
segundo_factor.alta_enlace: If you're on your phone, open the app with this link
segundo_factor.alta_paso3: Enter the code the app shows now:
segundo_factor.codigos_entrada: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Store them somewhere safe now: they won't be shown again.
segundo_factor.codigos_nota: Print them or keep them in your password manager. Any previous codes no longer work.
segundo_factor.cuenta_nota: To generate new recovery codes (the old ones will stop working), enter the code your app shows now.
segundo_factor.cuenta_sin_alta: Not on yet: you'll be asked to turn it on next time you sign in.
error.codigo_incorrecto: The code is wrong or was already used. Enter the one the app shows now.
api.segundo_factor_pendiente: The two-step verification code is missing.
